searchDocs.title: Rationale: Why?
searchDocs.content: Rationale: Why? TypedRemote is a simple library for declaratively handling remote instances. Similar to libraries likeNet, but with the additional support for type functions. Hooray for verbose parameters / returns! -- server local Event = TypedRemote.newReliableEvent("Event") :: TypedRemote.ToServerEvent<(fah: string, foo: boolean) -> ()> Event.server.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, fah: string, foo: boolean) -- do something end) -- client -- TypeError: Expected this [3.14] to be 'boolean', but got 'number' Event.client:FireServer("foo", 3.14)

searchDocs.title: newReliableEvent​
searchDocs.content: </> TypedRemote.newReliableEvent( remoteName: string-- Name for Event (reliable) ) → Event<toClientSignature,toServerSignature>-- Event (reliable) object Creates an Event (reliable) object, automatically creating a RemoteEvent instance named remoteName. -- server local ReliableEvent = TypedRemote.newReliableEvent("ReliableEvent") :: TypedRemote.ToServerEvent<(text: string) -> ()> ReliableEvent.server.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, text: string) foo(text) end) -- client ReliableEvent.client:FireServer("foo")

searchDocs.title: wrapReliableEvent​
searchDocs.content: </> TypedRemote.wrapReliableEvent( remoteEvent: RemoteEvent -- RemoteEvent instance for Event (reliable) object ) → Event<toClientSignature,toServerSignature>-- Event (reliable) object Creates an Event (reliable) object, using a passed RemoteEvent instance, remoteEvent. -- server local ReliableEvent = TypedRemote.wrapReliableEvent(Instance.new("RemoteEvent")) :: TypedRemote.ToServerEvent<(text: string) -> ()> ReliableEvent.server.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, text: string) foo(text) end) -- client ReliableEvent.client:FireServer("foo")

searchDocs.title: newFunction​
searchDocs.content: </> TypedRemote.newFunction( remoteFunctionName: string-- Name for Function object ) → Event<fromClientSignature,fromServerSignature>-- Function object Creates an Function object, automatically creating a RemoteFunction instance named remoteFunctionName. -- server local Function = TypedRemote.newFunction("Function") :: TypedRemote.FromServerFunction<(text: string) -> (string)> Function.server.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player, text: string): string return text end -- client local text: string = Function.client:InvokeServer("foo")
